role: Throwaway debug probe: dumps the client player's movement state (position, motion, onGround, collision flags, sprint, ySize, fallDistance, movement input, sprint key, movement-speed attribute and sprint modifier) as one JSON result between step commands, to pin a sprint or collision replay divergence to a row. Read-only.
used_by: make -C oracle run CLASS=PlayerDbg, or a script row {"cmd":"run","class":"PlayerDbg"}
notes: No native test or gate consumes it; no reference in oracle/tests or oracle/Makefile was found.
